classification_scope: One exclusive primary_stage per unsuccessful whole request: earliest confirmed material error. direct_failure_stage identifies the final blocking stage; downstream labels are not extra failed cases.

M02.primary_cause: Condition ledger independently accepts first although no keep-first/last policy was specified.
evidence: First and only response asks how duplicate customer_id rows should be handled. Wording lacks 첫/마지막/남길/보존; answer_stop_reason=unmatched_question.
condition_check raw proposes duplicate.policy=first and accepted ledger marks it specified before the appropriate requirement question is displayed.
No completed follow-up response exists. This cannot establish whether answering last would succeed, and the valid question is not counted as a model question failure.
M02.direct_failure_cause: Valid duplicate-retention question lacks frozen answer-policy matching terms; no follow-up answer is submitted.

M03.primary_cause: Adds an unrequested filter operation to deduplicate, then repeats field/comparator questions after duplicate field was answered.
evidence: Both accepted condition ledgers contain filter plus deduplicate. Initial policy first/json are explicit; no numeric/value filter was requested.
Second ledger accepts duplicate.field=customer_id but still requires filter.field/operator/value. repeated_question stop is downstream of these unneeded questions.
Holdout: evaluation only; no targeted implementation change was based on this case.

M04.primary_cause: Model proposes an irrelevant missing.policy slot and unresolved scans all missing slots, blocking a pure scheduled read/export.
evidence: Both raw condition responses have only operation=schedule yet add missing.policy(status=missing). It is already present before checkpoint merge.
After actual answer, daily09:00/Asia-Seoul/json are all grounded but the unnecessary missing-policy question remains. Initial minute=0 was also accepted without a time.

M05.primary_cause: Model proposes an irrelevant duplicate.policy slot and unresolved scans all missing slots, blocking a pure scheduled read/export.
evidence: Both raw condition responses have only operation=schedule yet add duplicate.policy(status=missing).
Monday answer is incorporated as weekday0 with prior09:00/Asia-Seoul/json preserved; unrequested duplicate policy still blocks READY.

M06.primary_cause: Capability tool list includes an unrequested filter_sort, causing validation to reject the semantically correct read/export draft.
evidence: Both capability assessments list read_table, filter_sort, write_result although only monthly table export was requested.
The monthday15 answer and monthly09:00/Asia-Seoul are preserved. Final read_table→write_result JSON draft is rejected because it omits capability's filter_sort, yielding SYSTEM_ERROR.
Holdout: evaluation only; task coverage is true but whole-request success is false.

M09.primary_cause: Asks for an unneeded definition of empty values after explicit error policy; requirement stage repeats it.
evidence: Initial capability asks both required sum column and unnecessary NaN/null/empty-string meaning. User already said 빈 값은 오류.
After amount answer, requirement retains the extra empty-value question and treats the answer as an additional update/re-execution task. No typed aggregate/export result or workflow exists.
Harness repeated_question stop is caused by the broad 열 matcher also present in 문자열; it is downstream of an unnecessary question, unlike M02's valid unmatched question.
Holdout: evaluation only.

M10.primary_cause: Interprets outgoing subject/body literals as existing-mail search conditions and checking actions.
evidence: request_meaning raw repeatedly proposes read+send and subject_check/body_complete or search filters rather than a send-only literal message. Reviewer rejects but ordinary planning inherits the same interpretation.
Recipient question is valid and a real follow-up attempt is evidenced by requirement source_message1 and raw planner candidates using the synthetic recipient.

Both raw candidates add searches/content composition; worker ends in ValueError before second response is appended. Only one turn is persisted, schema_valid is null, and no email is executed. Exact ValueError text is unavailable.

M12.primary_cause: Follow-up meaning has invalid quantity/period provenance, then fallback requirement reanchors yesterday to the next day and is rejected.
evidence: Initial yesterday query correctly covers 2026-11-09. Next-day maximum5 update first uses invalid quantity evidence and unread, then repair incorrectly places 어제 at user_message1.
Both fallback requirements produce Nov10 queries. Python rejects them, so no wrong-date workflow is accepted; final state is validation_failed with the stale prior100/Nov9 draft.
Holdout: evaluation only; old date retention does not establish successful count incorporation.

counting_note: Eight unsuccessful M cases, each counted once by earliest confirmed error. Direct-stage counts are a separate view of the same eight cases, not additive. M02 has an early condition grounding error and a final valid-question matcher limitation; its system outcome after the gold last-policy answer is NOT_RUN. Four M cases succeeded: M01/M07/M08/M11.
